system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Staff (Bound)

One of Iriolarthas's own, and still the single most dangerous thing a character can pick up in Ythryn. It has the following Powers:

  • (+2) Trinket: Deals an extra +2 Spell damage.
  • (+2) Armor: +2 bonus to Armor while the staff is held.
  • (+2) Protection: +2 bonus to Saves while the staff is held.
  • Force Bolt: Expend a charge to strike a Being within Far with a bolt of force for 5d6 damage, or swing the staff in melee for an extra 1d6.
  • Retributive Strike: Holds 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Break the staff to release its remaining power in a Far Sphere for 16d6 damage, halved by distance. The wielder is destroyed.

Value: 25000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
